title: Project risks · Practice
description: Explain how to identify uncertainty, choose responses and keep risks under review. Three original practice questions.

keyIdeas.text: Record uncertain events early and assess both their likelihood and their effect on project objectives to decide which need attention.
Choose a proportionate response, name a responsible owner and define warning signs and actions before a threat occurs.
Revisit risks throughout delivery, check whether responses work and update the register when conditions or warning signs change.

misconceptions: The most likely risk must always be the most important risk.
A risk register removes the need for response owners.
Risks only need to be assessed at kickoff.
